🎬Maa Behen (2026)

Maa Behen is an upcoming dark comedy that follows a dysfunctional family whose ordinary lives spiral into complete chaos after an unexpected crime turns their home into the center of a bizarre mystery. As secrets begin to unravel, every attempt to fix the situation only creates more hilarious misunderstandings, leading to a rollercoaster of suspense, comedy, and family drama.

Directed by Suresh Triveni, the film blends crime, humor, and emotional relationships into a fresh entertainer unlike typical Bollywood comedies. With an ensemble cast and an intriguing storyline, Maa Behen has already generated significant buzz among audiences and is one of the most anticipated Netflix originals of the year.

Featuring Madhuri Dixit, Triptii Dimri, Ravi Kishan, Arunoday Singh, Dharna Durga, Geetanjali Kulkarni, and Paresh Rawal, Maa Behen promises a unique mix of mystery, laughter, and unexpected twists.
